Messages.Body:
Does Black Cat's special ability apply when:

(1) doing the action allowed by "Vast Wealth"
(2) paying for the "Peace Treaty"
(3) initiating an equip action, then subsequently taken over
by Mask of 1000 Faces
(4) taking over an equip action with Mask of 100 Faces

Thanks.

--

"Live Life with Heart."

Alan Kwan kw...@cs.cornell.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
kw...@cs.cornell.edu (Alan Kwan) writes:

>Does Black Cat's special ability apply when:

>(1) doing the action allowed by "Vast Wealth"

Yes. "pay ... as usual" (card text)

>(2) paying for the "Peace Treaty"

Yes. (answer from DTR 11/9/94)

>(3) initiating an equip action, then subsequently taken over
> by Mask of 1000 Faces

No. Cost for action is paid when the action resolves.

>(4) taking over an equip action with Mask of 100 Faces

Yes. Cost for action is paid when action resolves.
